title: Dynamic Profiles id
description: A generic identifier string used for NodeDef/Editor/Property/Cmd/LinkDef ids across the Dynamic Profiles object model (design/developers/plugin_model.md §3). Deliberately permissive: real ids in the spec's own worked examples are not case- or format-constrained (e.g. "CTL", "ST", "online", "I_STD", "mv") -- unlike iox-vscode-plugin's stricter ioxplugin-dialect id patterns (e.g. node.properties.schema.json's ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$), which this schema does not carry over. Parameter.id is the one exception that must NOT use this $def -- it may legitimately be an empty string (the default parameter) per plugin_model.md's Parameter table, so parameter.schema.json declares its own unconstrained `type: string` instead.
